title: Levinson-Durbin
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox/Math Functions/Matrices and Linear Algebra/Linear System Solvers/Levinson_Durbin.md
text: Solve linear system of equations using Levinson-Durbin recursion, 1 input, 3 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Output(s)} sets Output(s); {Output prediction error power (P)}, {If the value of lag 0 is zero, A=[1 zeros], K=[zeros], P=0}, {Rounding mode}, {Saturate on integer overflow}, {Product output}, {Accumulator}, {Polynomial coefficients (A)} sets the polynomial coefficients data type fixdt, {Reflection coefficients (K)} sets the reflection coefficients data type fixdt, {Prediction error power (P)} sets the prediction error power data type, {Minimum}, {Maximum} and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Output(s)
params.values: Output(s) K (default) | A and K | A

params.name: Output prediction error power (P)
params.values: Output prediction error power off (default) | on

params.name: If the value of lag 0 is zero, A=[1 zeros], K=[zeros], P=0
params.values: If the value of lag 0 is zero, A=[1 zeros], K=[zeros], P=0 on (default) | off

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Saturate on integer overflow off (default) | on

params.name: Product output
params.values: Product output Inherit: Same as input (default) | numeric type

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Accumulator Inherit: Same as input (default) | Inherit: Same as product output | numeric type

params.name: Polynomial coefficients (A)
params.values: Polynomial coefficients data type fixdt(1,16,0) (default) | numeric type

params.name: Reflection coefficients (K)
params.values: Reflection coefficients data type fixdt(1,16,0) (default) | numeric type

params.name: Prediction error power (P)
params.values: Prediction error power data type Inherit: Same as input (default) | numeric type

params.name: Minimum
params.values: Minimum values of polynomial coefficients, reflection coefficients, or prediction error power [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Maximum
params.values: Maximum values of polynomial coefficients, reflection coefficients, or prediction error power [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
